__meta__.description: Comprehensive translation file for the memo system

no_active_session: No active session. Please run login first.
admin_privileges_required: Administrator privileges are required for maintenance tasks.
export_metadata_header: Export metadata: generated at {exported_at}, total memos {count}
export_redact_help: Redact memos at or above the specified security level before export.
export_checksum_help: Include memo checksums in the exported dataset.
export_compress_help: Compress the exported payload using gzip.
export_sign_help: Generate an HMAC-SHA256 signature file alongside the export.
rotate_key_help: Rotate the symmetric encryption key and re-encrypt stored memos.
rotate_key_not_available: Encryption rotation is unavailable (encryption disabled or libraries missing).
rotate_key_dry_run_summary: Dry run complete. {processed} memo(s) require re-encryption. {pending} update(s) pending.
rotate_key_failures: The following memos could not be re-encrypted:
rotate_key_backup_saved: Backup of previous key saved to {file}
rotate_key_backup_pruned: Pruned {count} old key backup(s) per retention policy.
verify_signature_help: Verify an export file against its HMAC signature.
verify_signature_file_help: Path to the exported file to verify.
verify_signature_path_help: Optional path to the signature file (defaults to FILE.sig).
verify_signature_invalid_format: Signature file {file} is missing required fields.
restore_key_backup_help: Restore the active encryption key from a stored backup.
restore_key_backup_file_help: Path to the backup key file to restore.
restore_key_backup_dry_run_help: Simulate restore and show memos that would be re-encrypted.
restore_key_backup_invalid: Backup file does not contain a valid Fernet key.
restore_key_backup_dry_run_summary: Dry run complete. {processed} memo(s) require re-encryption. {pending} update(s) pending.
restore_key_backup_success: Restored encryption key from {file}. {updated} memo(s) re-encrypted.
restore_key_backup_failures: The following memos could not be re-encrypted:
restore_key_backup_hash_mismatch: Digest mismatch: expected {expected}, got {actual}. Aborting restore.
verify_key_backups_help: Verify stored key backups against their manifest.
verify_key_backups_manifest_missing: Manifest not found. Run rotate-key first.
verify_key_backups_manifest_invalid: Could not load key backup manifest: {error}
verify_key_backups_missing: Tracked backup files missing on disk:
verify_key_backups_untracked: Unexpected backup files without manifest entries:
verify_key_backups_failure: Key backup verification failed. Investigate the issues above.
request_id_help: Optional correlation identifier for structured logs (cid=...).
maintenance_output_help: Write maintenance results to a file for automation use.
maintenance_fail_help: Return non-zero exit when maintenance reports errors.
health_output_help: Write health diagnostics to a file for automation use.
health_fail_help: Return non-zero exit when health checks fail.
admin_already_initialized: Administrator already initialized. Use login instead.
passwords_do_not_match: Passwords do not match. Try again.
login_success: Logged in as {username}. Session expires at {expires_at}.
admin_created: Administrator '{username}' created. You can now login.
warning_tags_removed: Removed {count} duplicate or empty tags from input.
warning_no_valid_tags: No valid tags remain after filtering.
warning_tags_truncated: Removed {count} tags to respect the maximum of {limit}.
limit_positive_required: Limit must be a positive integer.
